text:
alex: Heads-up — draft runbook for the new gpu cluster in us-west-2 is live. Need SRE handoff + paging config reviews before we flip traffic. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/gpu-us-west-2-runbook

maria: Thanks Alex. Quick skim looks good. Can you summarize the three concrete handoff items we need from SRE?

alex: Sure — short list: 1) PagerDuty service + escalation policy, 2) SLO/alert thresholds validated against perf tests, 3) 30m runthrough training with on-call so people know checklist and playbook.

kevin: For PD we should reuse the "inference-gpu" service and add a new escalation path for region leads. Suggest primary -> backup -> maria (sre-lead) -> eng-oncall rota.

jordan: Also confirm network egress firewall rules with infra-vpc team. Last region had a weird NAT gateway route issue that caused model download timeouts.

alex: Added a short validation checklist in the runbook: hardware inventory, NIC MTU, driver versions, container image pull test, model-download smoke test, token-perf smoke (1k reqs at 95th latency budget). Snippet I used:
```bash
# simple node validation
ssh gpu-node-01 -- sudo nvidia-smi
sudo ethtool -k eth0 | grep tx-checksumming
curl -fS https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/rw-models/hello-model.tar.gz -o /tmp/hello-model.tar.gz
```

maria: Good. For alerts, propose these mappings:
- P0: control-plane down (all nodes unreachable)
- P1: sustained GPU OOMs or GPU driver crash >= 2 nodes within 10 minutes
- P2: latency SLO breach for 5 min (95th > target)
- P3: perf degradation not impacting availability (queued items)

kevin: How do we detect GPU OOMs? Kernel logs or runtime metrics? We should include both. PD should page on telemetry + log signature. Example alert: `gpu_driver_crash_total{region="us-west-2"} > 0` AND `count_over_time(gpu_oom_events[10m]) > 1`

alex: I've added that expression to the alerting section. Also included runbook steps to triage:
1) Check node health with `kubectl get nodes` + `nvidia-smi`
2) If kernel oops, cordon + drain nodes matching label `gpu=true`
3) If model crash, rollback to previous model pin
4) If network, run `traceroute` to s3 endpoints and check NAT gateway metrics

jordan: For escalation paths, please include phone/SMS for P0s. We had on-call paging delays last quarter. PD escalation: 0 min to primary (SMS+push), 3 min to backup (call), 5 min to maria (call), 10 min to core infra pager.

maria: I'll validate the PD policy tomorrow. Also want a short training doc for new on-call: checklist + who-to-call matrix + key run commands. Alex can you paste the short checklist into the runbook top?

alex: Done — short checklist at top. Copy below for visibility: 
- Confirm PD service matches `inference-gpu-us-west-2`
- Run quick smoke: image pull + model download + 50 concurrent tokens test
- Run `kubectl top nodes` and ensure GPU utilization baseline < 60% before traffic shift
- Verify KV cache warming runs for common prefixes

kevin: Cost note — we plan to start with 40 GPUs (p4d-equivalent). Add card: expected burn ~ $X/day and a cost-alert if hourly spend > baseline by 30%. We need finance signoff on the monthly cap.

alex: Added cost section with an example Prometheus expression and a Grafana dashboard link. Finance already pre-approved the pilot budget but wants the cap.

sre-bot: PagerDuty service `inference-gpu-us-west-2` created (service id: svc_abc123). Escalation policy draft attached to the service.

jordan: Nice. One more operational note — we should include a network blackout window for setup (avoid route-table churn during traffic shifts). Recommend 30m window at midnight PST for minimal impact.

maria: Schedule the 30m training for next Wed 10:00 PDT? I'll invite the on-call rotation and post-runbook slack reminder 1h before.

alex: Scheduled and calendar invites sent. Also added a small troubleshooting section for common noises: driver mismatches, CUDA version drift, image cache corruption, and NVLink flapping. Example command to force kernel logs: `dmesg | grep -i nvidia`

kevin: LGTM. After training, can SRE owners mark the runbook as "handed-off" in the doc? We need an audit trail for the region launch.

maria: Yes. We'll add a final sign-off block: names, timestamps, PD service id, confirmed SLOs. I'll sign once PD policy validated and training done.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone finds holes in the runbook ping me here. I'll hold off on traffic switch until maria signs off. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll coordinate infra-vpc verification pre-switch.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled training event "us-west-2 GPU handoff" in 72 hours.

maria: Thanks — closing loop. Appreciate the clear checklist.
